whatIs.title: What is the CS Dictionary?
whatIs.description: An online dictionary covering 200+ essential terms across 10 CS fields: Data Structures, Algorithms, Network, OS, Database, Architecture, Software Engineering, Security, Linux, and Web Development. Each term includes a one-line definition, detailed explanation, and real-world analogy for easy understanding.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Search for terms in Korean or English using the search bar
Use the 10 category buttons to filter by field of interest
Check off learned terms with ✓ to track your progress
Bookmark important terms with ★ for later review
Click related term chips to navigate and learn connected concepts

tips.title: Study Tips
items: Start from beginner level to build a solid foundation before moving to intermediate and advanced
Follow related term links for connected learning to understand relationships between concepts
Use the learned checkmarks to study 10 terms per day consistently
Combine with the CS Quiz to verify your understanding for more effective learning

items.a: Yes! Every term includes easy analogies and real-world examples. Start from beginner difficulty and work your way up.
Progress is saved in your browser's local storage. Your learning history is preserved when you revisit on the same browser.

items.q: How does it connect with the CS Quiz?
items.a: Learn concepts in the dictionary first, then test your understanding by taking quizzes in the same category.
